expected: When POST /auth/login/mfa/verify returns the OpenAPI-declared HTTP 410 for an expired or otherwise invalid login challenge, the Web OTP flow returns to /w/auth/login and does not establish an authenticated session.
actual: After formatting, the focused auth-session Chromium suite passed 9/9. The page returned to /w/auth/login and auth-sign-out remained absent. Both TypeScript projects, focused ESLint and Prettier, lint-budget (0 errors/0 warnings), OpenAPI (15 contracts/154 operations), dependency-cruiser (863 modules/4679 dependencies, 0 violations), architecture inventory (129 pages/427 routes/149 components/32 services/28 mocks), EOL (3219 paths), and git diff --check passed. check-tracking exited 1 with 40 source-ledger errors: 32 missing catalogued source hashes, 5 paths absent from the catalogued head, and 3 source mismatches; the application inventory still contains 916/916 paths.
